root_dwell_basis: Separate final two-second near-goal occupancy and near-goal speed <=0.1 m/s from transient 0.5-second arrival; declared engineering threshold, not an official universal metric
root_goal_basis: Retain the project's existing score_root_goals radius and hold duration; engineering threshold, not a clinical or universal benchmark claim
foot_contact_basis: Sensitivity analysis using absolute skeletal foot-joint height around world Z=0; kinematic candidate contact, not measured contact force
physics_contact_basis: CLoSD native net rigid-body contact force; positive vertical support force, thresholds are engineering sensitivity settings. Foot-body origin translation is not contact-point slip velocity. Nonfoot net contact is not by itself a fall.
chois_metric_source: chois_release/evaluation_metrics.py:16-26,115-158,395-422,537-550. Rotation is mean ||I-Rpred inverse(Rgt)||F, not degrees or radians. Raw predicted object matrices are separately quaternion-projected for mesh geometry in trainer_chois.py:2618-2620.
independence: Paired differences within task and seed; bootstrap task-level means, not individual frames, constraints, or duplicated clock trajectories
